findings.description: The Diagram remark emits the literal TikZ environment and commands as rendered text. This is source syntax leaking into the local HTML, not a failed or mismatched mathematical diagram.

The theorem statement leaves category notation as literal ASCII TeX-like text (C^{1/n}→C^{1/n}, C_ex→C_ex, C_top→C_top, C_sm→C_sm); line 63 also renders AC_omega literally. Wrap these expressions in math notation.

Candidate topology/Mayer–Vietoris schematic, editorial value. The source names a knot exterior E_K with boundary basis μ,λ, a filling solid torus whose meridian attaches as α=pμ+qλ, and the resulting H1 quotient. A diagram could label T_K, E_K, the attached solid torus, α and a transverse β=rμ+sλ with ps−qr=1, then show the map α↦(p[μ],0), β↦(r[μ],±v). Confirm labels and orientation against the stated gluing before use.

Candidate ideal-tetrahedron/cusp-triangle schematic, editorial value. The source fixes ideal vertices 0,1,∞,z with Im(z)>0 and assigns z,z′=1/(1−z),z″=(z−1)/z to opposite edge pairs; a truncated vertex triangle can label the corner parameters and an oriented normal path’s left/right corner choices whose product defines H(γ). Check opposite-edge pairing and orientation labels against lines 38–40.
